title: Reversal Fee When a Refunded Web Hosting Plans Renewal Applied a Scheduled Change
content:
Billing desk note — reversal fee on Web Hosting Plans auto-renew refunds.

The auto-renew refund amount keeps back a reversal fee when the refunded line applied a change the customer had scheduled:

1. a change request of type term change in status applied whose effective date equals the refunded line's period start keeps back USD 15.00;
2. otherwise, a change request of type downgrade in status applied with that effective date keeps back USD 10.00;
3. a refunded line that applied no scheduled change keeps back no reversal fee.

**Reading the plan's change requests.**

| Applied term change request effective on the line's period start | Applied downgrade request effective on that date | Reversal fee |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | USD 15.00 |
| no | yes | USD 10.00 |
| no | no | none |

A request that is scheduled, withdrawn or declined, or whose effective date is a different date, does not count here.

**Example (hypothetical).** A refunded auto-renew line whose period starts on 1 July, on a plan with a downgrade request applied with effect from 1 July and no term change request: USD 10.00.
